name: @lions/net
description: Deterministic lockstep core: protocol, match config, frames, the clock, ownership and the transport seam. Runs in the browser, in Node and in the Worker. Imports @lions/sim types, plus five values from it: the FIRE_SUPPORT table's length, FIRE_SUPPORT_KINDS, AMBUSH_RADIUS_MAX, MAX_PRODUCTION_LINES and MAX_LINE_QUEUE (protocol.ts). The Worker's bundle pulls all five through @lions/sim's index, as it already did FIRE_SUPPORT.
